about: UAT-01 (BRD 19/10/2026): an investor finds the right file without remembering its name. Each query describes the content and never contains the file name. 'expect' = document title (prefix) in the Sao Mai demo corpus (make data, seed 7); any file with that title inside the asker's scope counts. 'must_not' = item ids the asker may never get (other group, internal, link shared by mistake).
